responsibility: Defines the IA-64 backend’s machine constraints used by reload, recog, and instruction selection. It names the target’s register classes and immediate, memory, symbolic, and vector-constant constraint letters—such as addl/branch/predicate/floating register classes, width-specific arithmetic immediates, small-address-area symbols, and non-postinc or nonvolatile memory forms—so md patterns in ia64.md, div.md, sync.md, and vect.md can precisely describe what operands the architecture and assembler accept.
